text: VARNA, Nov. 13 — Lindqvist Dairy has recalled its oat yoghurt after routine testing found trace levels of a cleaning compound in several batches, people familiar with the matter said. The recall covers 180-gram cups sold under the company’s Northfield label in the Varn and Elsen regions, with production dates from Oct. 28 to Nov. 4, according to the people. No illnesses have been reported, they said. Retailers began pulling the product from shelves Tuesday evening, and the company is advising customers to return unopened containers for a full refund. Lindqvist said the issue was isolated to one filling line at its Brakken plant and that production remains suspended pending review.
